features.name: Folding stock with shock pad and internal smartgun system
Own SPAS-22 art: compact rounded upper/body, short forward muzzle, raked grip and trigger opening; retain major stock/body boundaries

Assigned sole final reference reviewer inspected actual corrected raw clay, native independent foreground/masks, final2048 detail/clay teal images, clay mask and paired overlay against retained Arsenal printed28/PDF30 SPAS-22 authority. Rounded assault-shotgun body, folded shock-pad stock, thin upper stock members, major hinges/pivots, broad central part recesses, raised controls, raked grip and real trigger/guard opening retain matching structure and complete framing. Former shallow pad-face channels and tiny muzzle slot are filled in the new generated clay; grip texture, side vents, fine fastener-face recesses and small surface channels are smooth. Broad circular stock joints and large part boundaries remain structural. Independent alpha masks preserve the real guard opening and actual thin parts; no mask transfer/warp. Original detailed matte discarded only two one-pixel guard-edge AA fringe labels, not subject parts; normalization itself discarded zero components and filled zero holes. Common uniform crop/resampling only; native1254square RGB opaque originals honestly resampled2048. Selected clay is the new v50 generated correction, not any rejected manual trial. Reference-only approval; no geometry/client/production approval.
